payload.title: CHANGELOG.md contains Claude-Session URLs and 101 internal LIM- ticket IDs
payload.description:
**Problem**
The public changelog leaks internal tooling detail: agent session URLs and internal ticket IDs that mean nothing to readers.

**Evidence**
- CHANGELOG.md:428, :471 and :527 each contain `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_...`
- `grep -c 'LIM-' CHANGELOG.md` returns 101 (internal Kanbus ticket IDs).

**Fix**
Strip those lines and IDs from CHANGELOG.md, and fix the semantic-release changelog template/commit parsing so trailers and ticket IDs are not copied into future entries.

**How to verify**
`grep -c 'Claude-Session' CHANGELOG.md` returns 0 and `grep -c 'LIM-' CHANGELOG.md` returns 0, and the next generated release entry has neither.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
